title: Vampire Vape White Chocolate Hazelnut Tobacco 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape White Chocolate Hazelnut Tobacco Nic Salt offers a dessert-inspired take on Tobacco. The robust Tobacco base is softened by the creamy sweetness of White Chocolate, while roasted Hazelnut adds a nutty warmth that rounds out the profile. Formulated with nicotine salts for faster nicotine delivery and a smoother inhale, this 50VG/50PG blend is well suited to mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with pod systems, starter kits and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it’s an indulgent choice for vapers who enjoy Tobacco blends with sweet and nutty highlights.
